unmodelled.description: The claudeMdExcludes setting skips ancestor or monorepo CLAUDE.md files and rules by glob; the footprint counts them anyway.
AGENTS.md selection and the Project instructions setting decide whether AGENTS.md loads instead of, or beside, CLAUDE.md; the footprint reads CLAUDE.md files only.
Directories added with --add-dir load their CLAUDE.md files when CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD is set; the footprint ignores them.
Subagents may start without project instructions (omitClaudeMd), so what a subagent loads can be less than the main session loads.
